evaluation_contract.readiness: READY only when every selected mandatory rule is PASS, NOT_APPLICABLE (all predicate inputs present), or NEEDS_REVIEW resolved to PASS by an allowed reviewer with rationale. Any mandatory FAIL, unresolved NEEDS_REVIEW, UNABLE_TO_ASSESS or NOT_EVALUATED gives NOT_READY. Advisory rules never change readiness.
evaluation_contract.pending_decisions: A rule whose mandatory_decision_status is PENDING_OWNER_DECISION is treated as mandatory with its proposed on_violation outcome until decided.
evaluation_contract.nrc_baseline_extension: While D-04 is PENDING, a rule whose regulatory framework does not apply to the study is still applied (conservative), and each result it produces carries basis_flag APPLIED_VIA_PROPOSED_NRC_BASELINE so it is never presented as a regulatory requirement. If D-04 is REJECTED those rules return NOT_APPLICABLE; if APPROVED the flag reads APPLIED_VIA_APPROVED_NRC_BASELINE.
evaluation_contract.l2_rules: When study.l2_rules_status is RECORDED, the study-scoped L2 bundle (same schema; layer L2; scope.study_ids = [study]; basis type IRB_POLICY) must be loaded and evaluated in the same run. If its results are absent the outcome is UNABLE_TO_ASSESS (L2_NOT_EVALUATED); any mandatory L2 result other than PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE blocks readiness. CONFIRMED_NONE needs no L2 bundle.
evaluation_contract.review_resolution: Reviewers may resolve only NEEDS_REVIEW outcomes, on rules that allow it, with a rationale recorded via NRC-12. A FAIL cannot be overridden: the creative is corrected and revalidated, or a rule exception is proposed for policy-owner approval.
evaluation_contract.retrieval_gaps: Gaps reported by retrieval (the context manifest) are part of the saved result, not just the in-memory evaluation. For any mandatory rule with unresolved applicability, a missing source (SOURCE_MISSING), a rule conflict, or incomplete graph traversal, the saved outcome is UNABLE_TO_ASSESS (conflict: NEEDS_REVIEW), and validation PASS and readiness are blocked. Whole-context absence is one case of this, not the only one. A FAIL stays FAIL; gaps never upgrade or soften a FAIL.
evaluation_contract.deterministic_evidence: A deterministic check that passes is only PASS when the evidence it depends on was retrieved; if its required evidence is missing from the manifest the saved outcome is UNABLE_TO_ASSESS.
evaluation_contract.approved_wording_provenance: Required post wording (disclosures, approved phrases) is validated against its own study/language/version approval record. Source-quotation verification (verbatim match and sha256) applies only to source_quotations used as regulatory or platform evidence; approved wording is never required to appear verbatim in a source clause.
evaluation_contract.source_locators: L1 rules locate evidence by section plus the verbatim quoted span and its sha256. Paraphrased platform rules list section-level source_locations. Page snapshots and their sha256 are captured at ingestion.

changelog_from_0_1.change: Source quotations moved to source_quotations (EVIDENCE_ONLY, sha256 per span). required_post_wording now only points to study-snapshot disclosures (FACT-02) and the conditional investigational phrase (FED-04), selected by study and language. FACT-02 note narrowed.

FED-01 rewritten as an NRC-12 attestation bound to the creative version (reviewer id, timestamp); application approval and stale-version checks stay enforced. R1 acceptance recorded as PENDING (D-02), not accepted.

Regulatory applicability is study-specific: new CTX-01; each rule carries framework predicates. Applying FDA-derived rules beyond their basis is a PROPOSED NRC internal policy (D-04); such results are flagged APPLIED_VIA_PROPOSED_NRC_BASELINE. IRB of record and L2 status required before any PASS; recorded study-scoped L2 rules must be evaluated in the same run.

CH-03 TikTok rechecked against TikTok's US market table (copy supplied by NRC, 23 Nov 2026): no clinical-trial prohibition for the US. Changed from 'Blocked' to 'Allowed with conditions': 18+ audiences, local-law compliance, no promotion of the investigational product as a prescription medicine, privacy policy on landing pages. TikTok's policy index, Other Products and Services (incl. its global prohibited list) and Data Collection Standards were also read in full: none mentions clinical trials. The earlier US 'not allowed' search capture was a stitched fragment and is superseded.

CH-06 retired: Google audience limits now in CH-02 (S23 read in full); cross-platform ban is CTRL-02 (proposed NRC control). FED-10 whitelist moved to CTRL-01 (proposed NRC control). ORG-01 added; channel readiness split into paid and organic. X and Reddit not enabled. Section-level source_locations added for every paraphrased platform rule. CH-05 (LinkedIn) and CH-01 (Meta) rechecked against live-page text supplied by NRC on 23 Nov 2026; CH-01 now carries Meta's exhaustive cure-claim disease list and its health clickbait limit.

Every rule has an explicit outcome_policy (mandatory, decision status, on_violation, on_missing_evidence, blocking outcomes, review resolution). Reviewers may resolve only NEEDS_REVIEW; a FAIL cannot be overridden. FED-07 pending decision with NEEDS_REVIEW default; FED-08 NEEDS_REVIEW with reviewer resolution.

changelog_0_3.change: Evaluation contract: retrieval gaps (unresolved applicability, SOURCE_MISSING, conflict, incomplete traversal) must be carried into the saved result and block PASS/readiness for mandatory rules; a deterministic pass without its required evidence is UNABLE_TO_ASSESS; FAIL stays FAIL.

Required disclosures and approved phrases carry their own provenance (study, language, version, text_sha256, approval record) and are validated against it, never against source clauses. Quotation verification is limited to regulatory and platform evidence.

Governance: policy_owner approves meaning, disclosures and exceptions; policy_admin activates after checks; separate, audited permissions (D-16, decided 23 Nov 2026). D-01 now covers named approvers and any dual-role decision.
